dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Fresh flowers just arrived. If you're looking to brighten your day, come visit Fragrant Whispers and take a look."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "Added by Lilian for Miss Alodia: To help your flowers last longer in a vase, start by trimming the stems at an angle. Also remove the leaves near the bottom so they don't sit in the water and rot."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "Most flowers prefer clean water at room temperature. Fontaine's Romaritime Flowers and Lumidouce Bells like it a bit colder though, so adding a few ice cubes can help. Change the water daily and the flowers should last roughly twice as long. — Lilian"
